Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Cognizant Romania is home to 2400+ creative technologists and is one of Eastern Europe's largest Software Product Engineering delivery networks. We serve global clients in several industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communication Media & Technology, and Retail & MLEU (manufacturing, logistics, energy & utilities).
 Cognizant Romania was established in 2018 when Cognizant acquired Softvision, a company founded in the late 1990s in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We continue to build on our history as the preferred engineering partner for thriving Silicon Valley tech companies, now as a prominent Cognizant next generation studio.
 About the role 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Analytics Engineer with BigQuery, which is mandatory, to transform complex application events and IoT data into reliable, well-structured data models that can serve as a trusted source of information for the business.
 You will work with large datasets in BigQuery, build scalable data models using dbt, develop reporting solutions and ensure high standards of data quality, performance and documentation.
 Key responsibilities 
Transform raw application events and IoT data into clean, reliable and business-ready datasets.
Design and maintain scalable data models using dbt .
Write and optimise complex SQL queries in BigQuery .
Improve BigQuery performance and cost efficiency through effective partitioning, clustering, query optimisation and table design.
Build and maintain semantic models and dashboards using Looker or Power BI .
Model relationships between application events and IoT device signals.
Implement automated data-quality checks to identify anomalies in event and device data.
Create reusable dbt macros and use packages to maintain a clean and efficient codebase.
Document data models, business definitions and transformation logic.
Use Git-based development processes, including branching, pull requests and code reviews.
Collaborate with engineering, analytics and business teams to translate requirements into trusted data solutions.
Support continuous improvement of analytics engineering standards and practices.
 Required skills and experience 
Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering or a similar data-focused role.
Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience with Google BigQuery .
Strong understanding of BigQuery partitioning, clustering, slot usage, query optimisation and cost management.
Professional experience building modular, tested and documented data models with dbt .
Experience working with dbt macros and packages.
Hands-on experience with Looker or Power BI , including semantic modelling and dashboard development.
Strong knowledge of Git , branching strategies, pull request workflows and code reviews.
Experience modelling event-driven data, application events or IoT telemetry.
Experience implementing automated data-quality checks using dbt tests, Great Expectations or similar tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Clear communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
Ability to translate complex data into reliable and understandable business information.
 Nice to have 
Basic Python knowledge for scripting, API integrations or data orchestration.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or similar tools.
Understanding of streaming data and how information flows from connected devices into BigQuery.
Experience working with high-volume IoT or application-event datasets.

 Flexible Work Schedule – Outside of core working hours, you have the flexibility to arrange your schedule in a way that best suits your personal and professional needs.
 Flexible Hybrid Approach – We support a hybrid working model that helps you balance remote and office work. Employees based near a Cognizant office are expected to spend a minimum of 4 days per month onsite.
 Annual Leave – Enjoy 26 vacation days each year to relax, recharge, travel, and spend quality time with family and friends.
 Learning & Development – Access a wide range of training programs, workshops, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities to support your professional growth.
 Private Medical Insurance – Comprehensive healthcare coverage for your wellbeing and peace of mind.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential professional support services to help you navigate personal, emotional, financial, legal, or work-related challenges.
 Meal Tickets – Monthly meal allowance provided through meal vouchers.
 Referral Bonus Program – Help us grow our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
 Life Insurance – Additional protection and financial security
 Banking Benefits – Preferential banking services and financial products through our partner institutions.
 Bookster Library – Access thousands of books, audiobooks, and learning resources to support both personal and professional development.
